name: Photograph unveils
source: rasya-taste-v2 R02 (image mask reveal + drift) and R13 (clip-path reveal on enter)
look: One large photograph (or a row of two to six) is uncovered once as it comes on screen, a 1.3 s wipe from its foot (a row: foot, left, right in turn) while the picture settles from 1.4 to 1; a single photograph then drifts 6% against the page as it crosses the screen.
phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop (one clip and one transform a picture); under reduced motion the photographs stand.

needs.picture: one large photograph with one clear subject, or a row of two to six of one kind; each used once on the page
needs.words: the section's h2 and at most two lines
